name: Creamy Parmesan & Chicken Risotto
whyItWorks: Arborio white rice releases starch that creates a velvety sauce using only chicken bone broth, butter, and aged parmesan - zero heavy cream needed.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer arborio rice in warm chicken broth, finish with butter and aged parmesan, and top with pan-seared chicken tenders or scallops.
